banner.title: excalidraw
banner.tagline: Serves the Excalidraw whiteboard as a stateless static web app on the internal gateway.

explainer.title: One container, no state on the cluster

steps.title: Route
steps.text: HTTPRoute excalidraw attaches to the https listener of envoy-internal, so the app is reachable on the internal domain only.
steps.scene: a globe with an internal gateway arch

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: One container serves the static bundle on port 80. Liveness and readiness probe the same port.
steps.scene: a single container block serving a page

steps.title: Draw
steps.text: Scenes live in the browser, not in the cluster. Nothing is written to a volume, so there is no claim to back up.
steps.scene: a whiteboard sketch of boxes and arrows

facts.label: PVCs: scenes stay in the browser
